title: You May Not Finish What You Started
paragraphs: Our Creator is the Creator of generations. I conducted a simple study of his approach years ago, and discovered that he never addresses you. I know this sounds strange, but whenever he speaks, he's not talking to you. He is speaking to your offspring. He is always speaking to your offspring. Look, when he speaks, he is addressing what you carry inside you, not you. He used to say things like, " Your offspring will be blessed." He is not talking to you. "Through you, the nations will be blessed."

He is not talking to you. It speaks to what you carry within you. He always thinks beyond you. You, you are just a temporary being. Listen. Stop thinking that you are permanent. It's not about you. It is about the eggs she carries, and it is about the sperm she carries. This is the crux of the matter. He thinks from a generational perspective. That's why today feels like a thousand years. Let me tell you what we think, and it may be deeply disturbing to us. We believe we were born to finish what we started.
Direction and succession are about accepting the fact that you may not finish what you started.
